sources.notes: FeatureServer Hosted/Parcel_Boundaries_of_Indiana_Current/FeatureServer/0 (service item ce78e8017fcb479c81a06a6255cfcfa6; editingInfo.lastEditDate 2026-10-06). Hub item 70565d886f1e4528a43a86be6ce5c2f3 points at the same service but its metadata still describes the 2022 release (modified 2024-01-29). maxRecordCount 2000. Queried 2026-11-06: 3,682,675 features; 208,229 with a 3-character dlgf_prop_class_code of 3xx or 4xx (200,473 distinct state_parcel_id). Marion County 18097 is 20,771 of those features (20,543 distinct) and is not in this file list. The other 91 counties are 187,458 features (179,930 distinct state_parcel_id) in 141 pages. No owner field. loaddate is the county harvest date (min equals max inside each county on this query). gisdata.in.gov/robots.txt returns 301 to the portal home page (HTML, no Disallow rules); gisdata.in.gov/server/robots.txt is 404. www.arcgis.com robots.txt allows all. dataharvest.gio.in.gov and www.indianamap.org set Crawl-delay 60 and are not used.
